options.description: When a known problem changes (a fix lands, it is proven, or it comes back), plumb tells the session that owns that debug case, as a plumb line at its next prompt. Other sessions are told nothing. Needs a small addition to the pane branch.
options.label: The case's own session (Recommended)

options.description: Any change to the known problems reaches every running session at its next prompt. Simple, but sessions with nothing to do with the problem get the line too.
options.label: Every open session

options.description: No session is told; the pane and the band line show the change to you, which they already do live. Nothing to add.
options.label: Only your band

options.description: The relayed words aren't what you meant; nothing is added and you explain in your next message.
options.label: Not my words

payload.question: On the known-problems pane, the coordinator relayed your words "warn the responsible claude session if it changes anything". The pane itself only shows things and changes nothing. Which warning did you mean?
